title: Abiogenesis
description: Where chemistry becomes life. Unlocks the Abiogenesis Crucible and the Spark of Life.

puzzle.goal: Self-copying molecules of length L compete: the master sequence (fraction x_0, fitness f_0) is copied without any error with probability q^L, while the population as a whole is held constant by diluting everything at the mean fitness. Write the rate of change of the master sequence's fraction, ignoring back-mutation, with the mean fitness written as a ratio of sums over all sequence types j.
puzzle.name: Quasispecies equation (Eigen's error threshold)
puzzle.form: x _ 0 * ( f _ 0 * q ^ L - sumk ( j , f _ j * x _ j ) / sumk ( j , x _ j ) )
puzzle.ask: The master survives only if q^L > 1/s, where s is its fitness advantage over the mutant cloud; for q near 1 this means L < ln s/(1 − q). Find the longest genome that can be kept.
puzzle.method: Growth is fitness times error-free copying; dilution removes each type at the population's average fitness. Find when the master's growth rate stays above the mutants' at steady state.
